title: Pyramid World
body:
# 🏺 Pyramid World

### A Cross-Play Minecraft Network Inspired by the Mysteries of Ancient Egypt

Welcome to Pyramid World, a custom Minecraft network where Java and Bedrock players can adventure together through unique gameplay, powerful custom systems, and an Ancient Egypt-inspired world.

Whether you want to build a Skyblock empire, dominate LifeSteal wars, defend your base with Guardians, or hunt down the legendary Dragon Egg, Pyramid World offers an experience unlike any other.

---

# ☁️ Skyblock

Start with a small island and grow it into a powerful empire.
Earn money through spawners, expand your island, unlock upgrades, and compete against other players for the top rankings.

### Skyblock Features

🏝️ Island Creation & Progression

💰 Spawner-Based Economy

👥 Co-op Islands with Friends

📈 Island Level Leaderboards

🎁 Daily Rewards

📦 Pyramid Crates

⚒️ Custom Egypt Tool Skins

👹 Custom Mobs

👑 Custom Bosses

🏆 Seasonal Competitions

The strongest islands earn a place in Pyramid World history. At the end of every season, top players receive Hall of Fame NPCs that remain visible in future seasons.

---

# ❤️ LifeSteal

Every heart matters.

Lose hearts when you die and steal hearts from your enemies. Build powerful teams, defend your territory, and fight for control of the server.

### LifeSteal Features

❤️ Heart Stealing System

👥 Team Progression

🏰 Team Bases

🛡️ Guardian Defense System

📦 Team Storage

❤️ Team Heart Storage

⚔️ Team Wars

🏆 Team Reputation Rankings

🚨 Base Defense Alerts

🎯 Daily Rewards & Quests

---

# 🐉 Dragon Egg Power

One Dragon Egg.

One Server.

Unlimited Conflict.

The Dragon Egg is the most valuable artifact on the server. Teams can activate its power to gain bonus hearts and prove their dominance.

If the Dragon Egg holder falls in battle, the artifact can be stolen and claimed by a new owner.

Protect it.

Steal it.

Fight for it.

Become a legend.

---

# ✨ Ancient Egypt Features

🏺 Ancient Egypt Theme

⚒️ Custom Egypt Items

👹 Custom Egypt Creatures

👑 Powerful Boss Battles

🏜️ Custom Builds & Environments

The entire Pyramid World experience is inspired by the mysteries, treasures, and legends of Ancient Egypt.

---

# 🌐 Cross-Platform Support

✅ Java Edition

✅ Bedrock Edition

Play with friends no matter which version of Minecraft you own.

---

# 🌎 Community

Stay connected with the Pyramid World community, receive announcements, participate in events, and get support.
